hints: Store the graph as an edge list - Bellman-Ford loops over edges, never over vertices' neighbours.
Skip any edge whose tail is still INF. INF + (-3) is a smaller number than INF, so without the check 'unreachable' vertices slowly start looking reachable.
A negative cycle that s cannot reach does not affect any distance from s, and the INF check is exactly what stops it from being reported. Test 3 has that case.
source: DSA theory syllabus; Week 4 Q3 is the same algorithm on a grid
title: Bellman-Ford: distances with negative edges
